mapper.select: select id, aftersales_id, parcel_no, received_at, received_by, inspection_result, issue_description, inspected_at, inspected_by from warehouse_record where aftersales_id = #{aftersalesId}
select id, aftersales_id, parcel_no, received_at, received_by, inspection_result, issue_description, inspected_at, inspected_by from warehouse_record where aftersales_id in #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into warehouse_record (aftersales_id, parcel_no, received_at, received_by, inspection_result, issue_description, inspected_at, inspected_by) values (#{aftersalesId}, #{parcelNo}, #{receivedAt}, #{receivedBy}, #{inspectionResult}, #{issueDescription}, #{inspectedAt}, #{inspectedBy})
mapper.update: update warehouse_record set inspection_result = #{inspectionResult}, issue_description = #{issueDescription}, inspected_at = now(), inspected_by = #{inspectedBy} where aftersales_id = #{aftersalesId} and inspection_result is null
